The agent with the most failed runs before October 28 2026 is **research-agent**, which had **7 failed runs**.

```json
{
  "question": "Which agent had the most failed runs before October 28, 2026, and how many?",
  "sql": "SELECT a.name, COUNT(r.id) AS failed_count\nFROM runs r\nJOIN agents a ON r.agent_id = a.id\nWHERE r.status = 'failed' AND r.finished_at < '2026-10-28'\nGROUP BY a.name\nORDER BY failed_count DESC\nLIMIT 1;",
  "row_count": 1,
  "answer": "research-agent had the most failed runs, with a total of 7."
}
```
